allow: PowerShell(Get-NetFirewallRule -Enabled True -Direction Inbound | ForEach-Object { $r = $_; $p = $r | Get-NetFirewallPortFilter -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($p.LocalPort -eq 5000\) { [pscustomobject]@{ Name=$r.DisplayName; Action=$r.Action; Profile=$r.Profile; Protocol=$p.Protocol; Port=$p.LocalPort } } } | Format-List | Out-String -Width 200)
